doc: The four ghost forms Rivet transforms into (features/souls GhostForms; the owner, 2026-11-04: Tonnage, Dent, Kerf, Ohm). Each row is one form: power = its cost row in powers.json (madness_cost, duration_s, cooldown_s; tonnage -> hauler and dent -> gearbox keep the old power ids as aliases until the morning merge, so saves and quest 1 keep working). radius_m is the body's footprint radius and body_class its collision class (bodies.json); top_mps, accel_mps2 and turn_dps its locomotion (Rivet walks 6.75 and sprints 9.3 m/s). size_k is the drawn height against base Rivet (Tonnage about 3x, Ohm smaller than Rivet). enter_s is base Rivet into the form, exit_s the form back to base (each 0.5-0.9 s, two stages: the midpoint is the one in-between pose); switch_s (top level) is form to form through a teal flash, no base pass. anchors are the attack emit points in metres in the body frame (+x forward, +y right) for the ghost-powers lane. gait names the locomotion cycle. upgrade_tier is the per-act quest upgrade level (0 tonight; quest rewards land later). name_key is the Loc key of the player-facing name. story_voice (top level): the shipped story path (quest 1 without --rigs) draws the teal apparition beside Rivet on each whisper (StoryVoice); false = the whisper rings alone. story_forms (top level): the shipped story's sprite cast draws the ghost bodies, the teal morph and the HUD card while Rivet is in a form (StoryForms; Rivet's sprite steps out); false = the old sprite path (the Hauler grows Rivet's sprite, the other forms draw nothing).
